Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: Statement 1| After mapped into feature space Q through a radial basis kernel function, 1-NN using unweighted Euclidean distance may be able to achieve better classification performance than in original space (though we can’t guarantee this). Statement 2| The VC dimension of a Perceptron is smaller than the VC dimension of a simple linear SVM.

Options: 
A. Partly True, Partly False
B. Partly False, Partly True
C. True, False
D. True, Partly True
E. False, False
F. True, True
G. False, Partly True
H. Partly False, True
I. Partly True, False
J. False, True

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
